External VeraCrypt fixture

hash_sha512.hc is a real VeraCrypt console 1.26.29 (Debian 12 amd64)
container, created with AES/SHA-512/PIM 0/FAT and password
"veracrypt interop fixture password". The package SHA-256 is
62405d1a0c958995ace30267b0007537e3b0b8efee32b424262a752127d5218c.
The marker is MARKER.TXT = "interop fixture hash_sha512 AES sha-512\n".

The complete external matrix is generated by scripts/gen-vault-interop-fixtures.sh
using the pinned VeraCrypt package in scripts/vault-interop/Containerfile. The
matrix is intentionally not checked in (~466 MiB before the exFAT addition).
